subject: Request: Isolated Sandbox Allowance and Compliance Onboarding — MedVera POC
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diane Morales <diane.morales@medvera.io>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Isolated Sandbox Allowance and Compliance Onboarding — MedVera POC

Hi Diane,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited about where this could go. As mentioned, MedVera's data classification requires an isolated evaluation environment (VPC / private nodes) and we'd like to propose a short evaluation: 2 weeks, up to 100k tokens/day, isolated nodes only.

Two asks to get the POC moving:
- A one-time isolated-sandbox credit/allowance to cover the GPU/infra cost for the 2-week run (estimate below).
- A short compliance onboarding check (SOC2 scope extract + network diagram) so your security team can sign off on the environment before we provision.

Rough estimate: $7,500 in infra credits (or equivalent token allotment) to cover dedicated nodes + secure egress for the pilot. This is a standard path we offer for compliance-driven pilots and we can put conditions in an addendum (audit window, access list, data retention policy).

If procurement needs a formal grant letter or a SOW draft, I can attach one — Ben from SE and Kimberly from finance are looped for approvals. Can you confirm the primary procurement contact and any required PO language?

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: initial-poc-outline.md]
From: Diane Morales <diane.morales@medvera.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Isolated Sandbox Allowance and Compliance Onboarding — MedVera POC

Hi Soojin — thanks for the follow up.

Procurement contact is procurement@medvera.io (cc'd). Our security team asked for:
1) SOC2 scope documentation showing that inference nodes for the POC will be isolated and that logs/audit trails are retained for 90 days.
2) A short network diagram and the onboarding checklist for private deployments.

On credits: procurement will need a written authorization of the allowance (credit amount and conditions), plus a billing contact for invoicing any overages. Can Ben or Kimberly share a template for the authorization?

I'll aim to get security feedback by end of day Thu.

— Diane
Diane Morales
Director, Cloud Integrations
MedVera Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diane Morales <diane.morales@medvera.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Isolated Sandbox Allowance and Compliance Onboarding — MedVera POC

Hi Diane — great to meet you virtually. I'm the SE supporting the POC. Attaching a short packet that includes: SOC2-scope-extract.zip (redacted scope for POC), isolated-node-setup-guide.pdf, and a one-page onboarding checklist.

Highlights:
- Nodes will be deployed in a VPC with customer-controlled subnets and no public ingress.
- Audit logs (token-level request logs) can be retained for 90 days and exported to your SIEM via secure delivery.
- We can enable an access allowlist and short-lived service keys for the pilot.

For the credit authorization, here is a suggested wording you can forward to procurement: 
"Redwood Inference will provide MedVera with a one-time isolated-sandbox allowance of $7,500 covering dedicated node run-time and secure egress for the two-week POC. Any usage beyond the allowance will be billed at standard rates; invoice and billing contact will be provided upon execution of the SOW addendum."

If you'd prefer token units instead of USD, we can also offer 150,000 token-credits for the POC.

Next steps: security review (from your side) -> sign SOW addendum -> we provision the isolated environment.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: SOC2-scope-extract.zip; isolated-node-setup-guide.pdf; onboarding-checklist.pdf]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@medvera.io, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Isolated Sandbox Allowance and Compliance Onboarding — MedVera POC

Hi Diane / MedVera procurement team,

Finance has reviewed the request and can approve a conditional one-time allowance. Terms below: 
- Approved allowance: $7,500 (or 150,000 token-credits).
- Validity: 14 calendar days from provisioning start date.
- Conditions: Signed SOW addendum and MSA addendum acknowledging isolated environment, audit window (90 days), and non-production data limits.
- Audit hold: Redwood will retain POC logs for 90 days and provide access for a single compliance review within 120 days post-run.

Please note: any infrastructure costs incurred outside the approved VPC (e.g., egress to third-party services) are excluded from the allowance and will be billed separately.

If that wording works, please confirm and we will prepare a formal authorization letter (PDF) for procurement to attach to your PO.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: authorization-letter-template.pdf]
From: Diane Morales <diane.morales@medvera.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 15:48:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Isolated Sandbox Allowance and Compliance Onboarding — MedVera POC

Hi all — this is perfect, thank you. Procurement confirms the wording is acceptable; I'll open a PO once we have the SOW addendum and the authorization letter. Security reviewed the attachments Ben shared and had one minor ask: can Pinehurst node logs be limited to metadata-level fields (no full-PHI) by default, with the option to enable full logs only under a signed access request?

If Redwood can make that default setting, we can sign the SOW addendum immediately and kick off provisioning next week. Also, can we book a 45-minute onboarding slot with Ben and an infra engineer on Mon 07/06 or Tue 07/07?

— Diane
